methods.name: SciPy rectangular linear assignment (modified Jonker-Volgenant)
methods.conditions: Minimize a finite rectangular cost matrix; each task exactly once, each worker at most once. Workers fewer than tasks means infeasible under this contract.
methods.initialization: Finite matrix with explicit worker/task order
methods.stopping: Library completion or external process timeout
methods.output: Row-major binary assignment, objective and termination status

methods.name: HiGHS mixed integer linear programming through SciPy
methods.conditions: Linear objective and constraints, finite input coefficients, integer decisions; binary one-to-one assignment also has this formulation. Infeasibility does not make the method inapplicable.
methods.initialization: Objective vector, constraint matrix, variable bounds and integrality
methods.stopping: Optimality, infeasibility, unboundedness, ten-second solver limit or external timeout
methods.output: Values if present and feasible, objective, termination status; feasible does not imply optimal
